intermediate.name: Puerto de Tibi
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Puerto de Tibi (120.2 km)

story: A long fight led to the formation of the break. Red Bull–BORA–hansgrohe closed the gap on the Alto de Tibi before the final escapee was caught inside 30 km. Under the initiative of Florian Vermeersch, a late four-man move formed. August refused to cooperate, while the other three worked well together. The group stayed clear and Andrew August sprinted to his first victory.
